svg.title: Figure 08 · Standard errors at equal production payoff budgets
svg.desc: Unit variances estimated from 250,000 independent normal draws, seed 1003. Antithetic methods use N/2 pairs. The combined control coefficient is estimated on this pilot sample; the curves project frozen-coefficient production errors and exclude pilot cost.
